items.title: VendorEvent

items.title: SceneTransitionEnded
items.description:
A scene transition has completed fully.

Note: Does not appear to trigger when the transition is interrupted by the user.

items.title: SceneTransitionVideoEnded
items.description:
A scene transition's video has completed fully.

Useful for stinger transitions to tell when the video *actually* ends. `SceneTransitionEnded` only signifies the cut point, not the completion of transition playback.

Note: Appears to be called by every transition, regardless of relevance.

items.title: GetHotkeyList
items.description:
Gets an array of all hotkey names in OBS.

Note: Hotkey functionality in obs-websocket comes as-is, and we do not guarantee support if things are broken. In 9/10 usages of hotkey requests, there exists a better, more reliable method via other requests.

items.title: TriggerHotkeyByName
items.description:
Triggers a hotkey using its name. See `GetHotkeyList`.

Note: Hotkey functionality in obs-websocket comes as-is, and we do not guarantee support if things are broken. In 9/10 usages of hotkey requests, there exists a better, more reliable method via other requests.

requestParams.name: hotkeyName
requestParams.description: Name of the hotkey to trigger

requestParams.name: contextName
requestParams.description: Name of context of the hotkey to trigger

items.title: TriggerHotkeyByKeySequence
items.description:
Triggers a hotkey using a sequence of keys.

Note: Hotkey functionality in obs-websocket comes as-is, and we do not guarantee support if things are broken. In 9/10 usages of hotkey requests, there exists a better, more reliable method via other requests.

requestParams.description: The OBS key ID to use. See https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/master/libobs/obs-hotkeys.h

items.title: GetSourceScreenshot
items.description:
Gets a Base64-encoded screenshot of a source.

The `imageWidth` and `imageHeight` parameters are treated as "scale to inner", meaning the smallest ratio will be used and the aspect ratio of the original resolution is kept. If `imageWidth` and `imageHeight` are not specified, the compressed image will use the full resolution of the source.

**Compatible with inputs and scenes.**

requestParams.name: canvasUuid
requestParams.description: UUID of the canvas the source is in, if using sourceName field

requestParams.name: sourceName
requestParams.description: Name of the source to take a screenshot of

requestParams.name: sourceUuid
requestParams.description: UUID of the source to take a screenshot of

requestParams.name: imageFormat
requestParams.description: Image compression format to use. Use `GetVersion` to get compatible image formats

requestParams.name: imageWidth
requestParams.description: Width to scale the screenshot to

requestParams.name: imageHeight
requestParams.description: Height to scale the screenshot to

requestParams.name: imageCompressionQuality
requestParams.description: Compression quality to use. 0 for high compression, 100 for uncompressed. -1 to use "default" (whatever that means, idk)

items.title: SaveSourceScreenshot
items.description:
Saves a screenshot of a source to the filesystem.

The `imageWidth` and `imageHeight` parameters are treated as "scale to inner", meaning the smallest ratio will be used and the aspect ratio of the original resolution is kept. If `imageWidth` and `imageHeight` are not specified, the compressed image will use the full resolution of the source.

**Compatible with inputs and scenes.**

requestParams.name: canvasUuid
requestParams.description: UUID of the canvas the source is in, if using sourceName field

requestParams.name: sourceName
requestParams.description: Name of the source to take a screenshot of

requestParams.name: sourceUuid
requestParams.description: UUID of the source to take a screenshot of

requestParams.name: imageFormat
requestParams.description: Image compression format to use. Use `GetVersion` to get compatible image formats

requestParams.name: imageFilePath
requestParams.description: Path to save the screenshot file to. Eg. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\screenshot.png`

requestParams.name: imageWidth
requestParams.description: Width to scale the screenshot to

requestParams.name: imageHeight
requestParams.description: Height to scale the screenshot to

requestParams.name: imageCompressionQuality
requestParams.description: Compression quality to use. 0 for high compression, 100 for uncompressed. -1 to use "default" (whatever that means, idk)
